extDescription.message: Name a topic: its tabs gather together, and the rest fold into a separate group.

topicPlaceholder.message: for example, AI agents, LLM, Claude API

topicHint.message: Describe the subject, not the goal: “AI agents, LLM” works better than “I want to become an AI engineer”.

noSuggestions.message: No clear topics found: the tabs are too different. Describe the topic yourself.

verdictOn.message: This tab is on the topic “$1”.

verdictOff.message: This tab is not about “$1”. When you leave it, it will fold into “$2”.
